exchange.sent: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication without making unsupported claims?

answer.answer:
已查到可引用的部分資料：

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a Wireless Communication competitor without unsupported claims, use formal R&S specifications/features documents for our products, official competitor documents or third-party evidence for the competitor, and avoid treating internal battle cards or sales language as binding technical specifications. [3][6][24][67]
### Evidence required
| Evidence area | What is required before making a comparison claim |
|---|---|
| Source type | Internal battle cards for CMX500 vs amarisoft, Anritsu, and Keysight are sales positioning, not binding technical specifications, so they cannot by themselves support technical comparison claims. [1][4][22][89] |
| R&S Signaling product proof | For CMX500 claims, use the CMX500 Specifications document `PD 5216.4127.22`, Version 11.00, August 2025, for binding specifications, and the CMX500 Features and Functions document `1179.1164.02`, Version 32 / CSW 9.20.0 and higher, for GUI, software features, signaling, application, measurement options, and interfaces. [67] |
| R&S Signaling option proof | If claiming WLAN, LTE, NR, NTN, RedCap, or NB-NTN signaling support, cite the specific CMX option codes and order numbers listed in the CMX500 features/options tables, such as WLAN signaling options CMX-KS350B to CMX-KS357B, LTE signaling CMX-KS500B/M/X, NR signaling CMX-KS600B/M/X, NTN CMX-KS627B/M/X to CMX-KS629B/X, and NB-NTN CMX-KS527B/X. [27][68][70] |
| R&S application / IP proof | If claiming application or IP testing, cite the CMX500 application options, such as CMX-KA100 for internal IP services and DUT IP connection tests, CMX-KA110 for QoS/ePDG/N3IWF/delay/IP tune, CMX-KA150 for IP traffic analysis, and CMX-KA180/KA181/KA401 for IMS audio and POLQA-related functions. [66] |
| R&S WLAN proof | If claiming WLAN signaling or WLAN TX measurement, cite the CMX500 WLAN evidence showing support for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn, AP testing, station testing, single-user 2x2 MIMO, advanced encryption/authentication, and WLAN measurement bandwidths up to 320 MHz depending on standard. [96] |
| R&S Non-signaling / production proof | If including CMP180 as the non-signaling / production path, cite CMP180’s formal product positioning as a Radio Communication Tester for production / wireless communication device testing, configurable with RF generator/analyzer, communication-standard measurement options, waveform options, and R&S VSE analysis capability. [28] |
| R&S Non-signaling specifications proof | For CMP180 claims, use the CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09 as an applications overview and CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00 / `PD 3609.7348.22`, March 2026, for specifications, general data, ordering information, warranty, and service. [30] |
| Alternative non-signaling tester proof | If including PVT360A, state only that its Features and Functions source positions it as a Performance Vector Tester focused on multi-wireless-standard waveform playback, TX/RX measurements, spectrum analysis, WLAN MIMO / composite MIMO, and external-front-end configurations up to 24 GHz to 50 GHz, while binding specifications still require `PD 3683.6212.22`. [46][47] |
| Competitor proof | For amarisoft, Anritsu, or Keysight comparison claims, obtain the competitor’s official product資料 and third-party evidence, because the battle-card claims about those competitors are currently single-source R&S internal positioning. [3][6][24] |
| Anritsu-specific proof | If comparing against Anritsu MT8000A figures such as FR2 43.5 GHz, 800 MHz bandwidth, 5 Gbps, or FR3 0.4 GHz to 16 GHz, add Anritsu official sources because the current MT8000A page has not imported an Anritsu official datasheet. [31][32] |
| Keysight-specific proof | If comparing against Keysight UXM models, add Keysight official资料 because the Keysight battle-card page states that it does not provide formal document numbers, versions, order numbers, or dates for E7515P, E7515W, E7515B, E7515E, or E7515R. [19] |
| amarisoft-specific proof | If using claims about amarisoft in customer documents, add amarisoft official資料 and third-party evidence because the current claims come only from an R&S internal battle card. [3] |
| Sales-language control | Do not present “Only R&S,” “safe and future-proof choice,” “only platform,” “industry-leading,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” “first,” or “leadership” as verified technical specifications unless supported by formal evidence. [3][6][24][88] |
| RFU18 / FR3 proof | Do not use RFU18, FR3, or 2000 MHz aggregated bandwidth claims as existing CMX500 binding specifications until formal RFU18 / FR3 documents provide order number, datasheet, release date, supported CMX500 configurations, calibration conditions, availability, and test conditions. [19][24][87][94] |
| Conformance / validation proof | For validated NTN, PTCRB, GCF, operator acceptance, RF/RRM/PCT, or conformance leadership claims, provide validation reports, test-case lists, PTCRB RFT 555 version/date, GCF evidence, or other official validation criteria, because the current battle-card evidence does not provide those items. [19][24][41][91] |
| Measurement validity proof | For R&S CMX500 specifications, include the stated conditions: 30 minutes warm-up after 3 hours at ambient temperature, specified environmental conditions, recommended calibration interval, and applicable internal automatic adjustments; non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values, measured values, and data without tolerance limits are not warranted or binding. [67] |
| Use-case proof | For callbox or use-case comparisons, add the complete option stack, BOM, DUT conditions, and test report because the CMX500 Callbox source does not list those for multiple use cases. [71] |
| Desense / interference proof | For WLAN + cellular desense comparisons, add formal procedure, pass/fail criteria, measurement uncertainty, DUT configuration, reporting format, bands, band combinations, and RF path requirements because those are unresolved in the desense source. [45] |
| TCO / workflow proof | For “lower TCO,” “fewer calibrations,” “fewer licenses,” or “higher test throughput,” provide a calculation or empirical dataset, because the Anritsu battle-card offensive play notes that no TCO formula is provided. [61] |

passages.text:
R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 與 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 提供 instrument-grade、validated、calibrated、可延伸至 production 的 5G testing path；[[amarisoft]] 則被描述為 COTS hardware + software-defined stack 的 functional testing solution。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- “Only R&S” 與 “safe and future-proof choice” 是 battle card 的 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- 對 [[amarisoft]] 的主張目前只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源；若用於客戶文件，應另查 [[amarisoft]] 官方資料與第三方證據。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Anritsu]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Anritsu positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 架構 | one-platform architecture；FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + Wi-Fi + RF + fading | multiple RF boards、external converters、multiple boxes；另依 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]，[[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 是 software-based [[Virtual Signalling Tester]]，可用 MAC / PHY Digital-IQ / RF interfaces | battle card 未提供正式 CMX500 RFU18 或 Anritsu module datasheet；MX844030PC brochure 未提供 CMX500 比較資料 |
| FR1 bandwidth | quick table: 500 MHz (& future scalable) | 200/400 MHz fixed limit；landmine 稱 max 400 MHz per module | R&S 500 MHz 口徑與既有 specifications 不完全一致，見 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] |
| FR2 | up to 50 GHz；source claim >16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth；>10 Gbps data rate | up to 43.5 GHz；800 MHz BW；up to 5 Gbps | R&S up to 50.20 GHz 與 specs 方向一致；>16 GHz bandwidth / >10 Gbps 仍缺正式規格來源 |
| FR3 | via upcoming [[RFU18]]；quick table says up to 18 GHz | new FR3 module 0.4–16 GHz | 兩方數字皆需正式 datasheet 驗證 |
| Fading | integrated / native fading | external PC software / chambers / software | source 未列 option code 對照 |
| IP throughput | native high-throughput IP testing | IP Option 012 + external PC | source 未列 throughput profile 或測試條件 |
| Software | single workflow / unified automation / Test Automation Suite | Battle card says SSNR + RTD + ATS + MX844030PC；[[mx844030pc-j1200]] says MX844030PC uses common RTD GUI for protocol test case transfer | battle card 是 R&S sales framing；Anritsu brochure 是 MX844030PC official product framing，兩者不可直接合併成單一事實 |
| WLAN | cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform；Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling inside CMX500 | MT8000A no WLAN；requires [[Anritsu MT8862A]] | CMX500 WLAN 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] |

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- 對 [[Anritsu]] 的 battle card 主張目前主要來自 R&S internal battle card；若用於客戶文件，應另查 Anritsu 官方資料與第三方證據。
- [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 是 Anritsu product brochure，可用於描述 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]]、[[Anritsu MD8190A]] 與 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]]，但不可用來驗證 R&S 對 CMX500 的優勢主張。
- Source 中的 only platform、industry-leading、widest frequency range、lower TCO 等語句是 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- FR1 / FR2 / FR3 bandwidth 與 data rate 相關矛盾與限制已集中標註於 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]]。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

R&S CMW500
R&S CMW500 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Wideband radio communication tester；[[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]（Version 17.00，April 2023）列出的訂購型號為 R&S®CMW500，Order No. 1201.0002K50；[[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]]（Oct. 2024，文件版次來源未標示）補充其搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] 或 [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 時的 [[NGeCall over LTE]] 測試支援狀態。

R&S CMW500 › 重要限制
- 來源明示：[[R&S CMW500]] 有時只支援部分測試，某些測試需要進一步設備。
- 多個 CEN/TS 17240 IVS 測試需要外部 HMI interaction、ignition switched OFF 控制、manufacturer specific AT command、IVS debugging tool、prepared TestUSIM 或 handset；這些不完全由 KA09x software 控制。
- CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available；需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS call-back abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 標示 Not available。
- 來源註明 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 [[NGeCall over LTE]] / IMS 的 transition 尚未由 EU commission 最終決定，因此部分涉及 handover 的 test cases 尚未實作。

R&S CMW500 › 規格條件
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。
- 需至少 15 minutes warm-up time，環境溫度與指定 environmental conditions 符合要求，calibration cycle 已遵守，且所有 internal automatic adjustments 已執行。
- `typ.` 為 typical values，在 final test 中驗證，但 Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Nominal values 為 design parameters，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Calibration interval：12 months recommended for highest accuracy；24 months 時需在 specified RF generator 與 RF analyzer level uncertainty 加上 0.2 dB。

- Nominal values 為 design parameters，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Calibration interval：12 months recommended for highest accuracy；24 months 時需在 specified RF generator 與 RF analyzer level uncertainty 加上 0.2 dB。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a Wireless Communication competitor without unsupported claims, use formal R&S specifications/features documents for our products, official competitor documents or third-party evidence for the competitor, and avoid treating internal battle cards or sales language as binding technical specifications. ### Evidence required
| Evidence area | What is required before making a comparison claim |
|---|---|
| Source type | Internal battle cards for CMX500 vs amarisoft, Anritsu, and Keysight are sales positioning, not binding technical specifications, so they cannot by themselves support technical comparison claims. [1][4][22][89] |
| R&S Signaling product proof | For CMX500 claims, use the CMX500 Specifications document `PD 5216.4127.22`, Version 11.00, August 2025, for binding specifications, and the CMX500 Features and Functions document `1179.1164.02`, Version 32 / CSW 9.20.0 and higher, for GUI, software features, signaling, application, measurement options, and interfaces. [67] |
| R&S Signaling option proof | If claiming WLAN, LTE, NR, NTN, RedCap, or NB-NTN signaling support, cite the specific CMX option codes and order numbers listed in the CMX500 features/options tables, such as WLAN signaling options CMX-KS350B to CMX-KS357B, LTE signaling CMX-KS500B/M/X, NR signaling CMX-KS600B/M/X, NTN CMX-KS627B/M/X to CMX-KS629B/X, and NB-NTN CMX-KS527B/X. [27][68][70] |
| R&S application / IP proof | If claiming application or IP testing, cite the CMX500 application options, such as CMX-KA100 for internal IP services and DUT IP connection tests, CMX-KA110 for QoS/ePDG/N3IWF/delay/IP tune, CMX-KA150 for IP traffic analysis, and CMX-KA180/KA181/KA401 for IMS audio and POLQA-related functions. [66] |
| R&S WLAN proof | If claiming WLAN signaling or WLAN TX measurement, cite the CMX500 WLAN evidence showing support for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn, AP testing, station testing, single-user 2x2 MIMO, advanced encryption/authentication, and WLAN measurement bandwidths up to 320 MHz depending on standard. [96] |
| R&S Non-signaling / production proof | If including CMP180 as the non-signaling / production path, cite CMP180’s formal product positioning as a Radio Communication Tester for production / wireless communication device testing, configurable with RF generator/analyzer, communication-standard measurement options, waveform options, and R&S VSE analysis capability. [28] |
| R&S Non-signaling specifications proof | For CMP180 claims, use the CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09 as an applications overview and CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00 / `PD 3609.7348.22`, March 2026, for specifications, general data, ordering information, warranty, and service. [30] |
| Alternative non-signaling tester proof | If including PVT360A, state only that its Features and Functions source positions it as a Performance Vector Tester focused on multi-wireless-standard waveform playback, TX/RX measurements, spectrum analysis, WLAN MIMO / composite MIMO, and external-front-end configurations up to 24 GHz to 50 GHz, while binding specifications still require `PD 3683.6212.22`. [46][47] |
| Competitor proof | For amarisoft, Anritsu, or Keysight comparison claims, obtain the competitor’s official product資料 and third-party evidence, because the battle-card claims about those competitors are currently single-source R&S internal positioning. [3][6][24] |
| Anritsu-specific proof | If comparing against Anritsu MT8000A figures such as FR2 43.5 GHz, 800 MHz bandwidth, 5 Gbps, or FR3 0.4 GHz to 16 GHz, add Anritsu official sources because the current MT8000A page has not imported an Anritsu official datasheet. [31][32] |
| Keysight-specific proof | If comparing against Keysight UXM models, add Keysight official资料 because the Keysight battle-card page states that it does not provide formal document numbers, versions, order numbers, or dates for E7515P, E7515W, E7515B, E7515E, or E7515R. [19] |
| amarisoft-specific proof | If using claims about amarisoft in customer documents, add amarisoft official資料 and third-party evidence because the current claims come only from an R&S internal battle card. [3] |
| Sales-language control | Do not present “Only R&S,” “safe and future-proof choice,” “only platform,” “industry-leading,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” “first,” or “leadership” as verified technical specifications unless supported by formal evidence. [3][6][24][88] |
| RFU18 / FR3 proof | Do not use RFU18, FR3, or 2000 MHz aggregated bandwidth claims as existing CMX500 binding specifications until formal RFU18 / FR3 documents provide order number, datasheet, release date, supported CMX500 configurations, calibration conditions, availability, and test conditions. [19][24][87][94] |
| Conformance / validation proof | For validated NTN, PTCRB, GCF, operator acceptance, RF/RRM/PCT, or conformance leadership claims, provide validation reports, test-case lists, PTCRB RFT 555 version/date, GCF evidence, or other official validation criteria, because the current battle-card evidence does not provide those items. [19][24][41][91] |
| Measurement validity proof | For R&S CMX500 specifications, include the stated conditions: 30 minutes warm-up after 3 hours at ambient temperature, specified environmental conditions, recommended calibration interval, and applicable internal automatic adjustments; non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values, measured values, and data without tolerance limits are not warranted or binding. [67] |
| Use-case proof | For callbox or use-case comparisons, add the complete option stack, BOM, DUT conditions, and test report because the CMX500 Callbox source does not list those for multiple use cases. [71] |
| Desense / interference proof | For WLAN + cellular desense comparisons, add formal procedure, pass/fail criteria, measurement uncertainty, DUT configuration, reporting format, bands, band combinations, and RF path requirements because those are unresolved in the desense source. [45] |
| TCO / workflow proof | For “lower TCO,” “fewer calibrations,” “fewer licenses,” or “higher test throughput,” provide a calculation or empirical dataset, because the Anritsu battle-card offensive play notes that no TCO formula is provided. [61] |

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源指出 smartphone Art 3.3g / [[Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019-320]] / E112 是沒有 ETSI EN standard 的 regulatory compliance requirement；當沒有 EN standard available 時需 Notified body involved，並稱 [[R&S TS-LBS]] 是 first test solution available to perform the necessary LBS compliance tests。
- [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]部分列出 [[47 CFR]]、[[ANSI C63.26]]、[[ANSI C63.10]]、[[IEEE Std 1528-2013]]、[[C63.19]] 等測試依據，並列出 licensed cellular CFR47 test items：RF power output、modulation characteristics、occupied bandwidth、band edge、spurious emissions、frequency stability、peak to average ratio、field strength of spurious radiation。
- 來源以 [[ITU-R SM.329-12]] 與 [[47 CFR §2.1057]] 對照 CE RED / FCC 的 frequency range：5G NR FR1 的 CE RED 30 MHz–26 GHz、FCC 9 kHz–40 GHz；5G NR FR2 的 CE RED 30 MHz–90 GHz、FCC 9 kHz–200 GHz；並提到 [[R&S FSV3000]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S ESW]]。
- [[NTN 裝置法規測試]]部分把 NTN device implementation 分成 proprietary、3GPP < R16、3GPP R17 NTN-IoT、reuse spectrum assets / 3GPP unmodified UE 等路徑，例子包含 iPhone 14 / Globalstar、Qualcomm / Iridium、MTK / Bullitt / Skylo、AT&T / AST Space Mobile、T-Mobile / Starlink、Optus / Lynk。
- 來源列出衛星 / NTN 相關 EN standards：[[EN 301 441]]、[[EN 301 442]]、[[EN 301 444]]、[[EN 301 681]]、[[EN 302 574]]、[[EN 303 981]]，並將 iPhone14、Bullitt defy satellite link、StarLink Dish 作為 DoC / market product examples。
- 來源將 [[EN 301 681]] 測試偏向 conducted measurement，列出 spectrum analyzer、signal generator、BER measure / system emulator / mobile radio tester 等 required instruments，並明示 latest [[R&S CMW500]] software can support 3GPP R17 NB-NTN signalling。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

1. 要覆蓋 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi 7、RedCap 與 NTN 時，需要多少 UXM models，且誰負責 integration？
2. 是否需要 integrated fading、Doppler 與 satellite mobility in one box，或能接受 RaySim / Channel Studio / ProbSim 等 external tools？
3. 是否需要 one unified automation environment，而不是 six separate tools？
4. 是否需要 Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 on every test configuration？
5. 是否需要 validated 3GPP NR-NTN conformance（RF + RRM + PCT）with ecosystem partner，以因應 operator 或 certification pressure？
